sentences.english_text: Drippy turned back to the window and as he started to climb through it he found himself trapped in a web of enormous ropes.
The ropes wouldn't be enormous to you but they were to Drippy.
It was a spider web and he was trapped right in the middle of it.
The ropes were sticky and he found that he could not get away.
He bounced up and down as hard as he could but he could not free himself.
I wonder how long I'm gonna stay here.
Not long.
A voice told him and he looked up and there above his head was an enormous black spider.
Not a friendly spider, oh no. This one was black and hairy and had mean red eyes.
I'm thirsty I'm glad you came along.
And as Drippy watched in horror the spider started down its web to drink Drippy.
Drippy was terrified.
He had no idea how he was going to escape.
You can't drink me.
I'm a hero.
I just saved a little girl's life.
The spider grinned evilly and said now you're gonna save my life.
And he swooped down at Drippy.
Across the room the movement of the spider caught the attention of the little girl's mother.
The mother saw the spider and the spider web and she said, the maid doesn't clean properly.
I must talk to her about that.
And the mother walked across the room and brushed away the spider web just before the spider could get to Drippy.
Drippy was knocked to the floor.
Drippy did not wait to see what happened to the spider.
He moved across the floor as quickly as he could and went past the little girl's bed and into the hall.
He wanted to get as far away from the spider as possible.
There was a closed door at the end of the hall.
The spider won't be able to get me there.
And he crawled under the door into the room.
